projects.description: Elm is a programming language for creating browser-based web apps. Elm for iOS (a.k.a. Elm Mobile) aims to bring the benefits of the Elm programming language, like no runtime errors, to mobile platforms like iOS. The goal of our project is to determine the feasibility of using Elm to create native mobile applications.
